svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Heatmiser Matter bridge: architecture as built
Firmware v0.6.0 (milestone 6) on a Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-7. ESP-IDF 6.1, esp-matter, LVGL 9 via esp_lvgl_port.
State: stat readings up to the screen and Matter
Commands: setpoint, mode, lock, hot water, clock
Saved state (NVS / flash) and internal calls
Aqara Hub M3, Apple Home and a third controller
Matter over Wi-Fi; pairing over BLE (QR / 11-digit
code on the Matter screen), up to 5 fabrics
ESP32-S3 N16R8: 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM, Wi-Fi + BLE
attr_cb: controller writes, endpoint IDs saved
nvs: zones/list (addr, model, name, endpoint ID),
poll, master, hw overrides, hwep*, Wi-Fi, PIN hash,
timezone, screen timeout, Matter fabrics and keys
zone_store: the hub between the bus, the screen and Matter (mutex guarded)
One zone_view per stat: live DCB values, programme,
Dirty bits with one copy per reader (UI, Matter)
Notices for toasts: failed write, scan result
Listens to hm_poller events; queues writes back to it
clock_check every 60 s: daily 03:10 sync, or a
stat more than 2 min out; override put back after
Hot water boost / forced on / off survive a restart
Bus counters and frame trace for diagnostics
Dashboard, quick adjust, Zone detail, Hot water
and boost, Schedule and HW timer editors,
Rename, Settings (PIN), Zones and scan, Bus
refresh 200 ms, tick 1 s, blank on idle
hm_bus task: sole owner of the RS485 bus
frame buffers in PSRAM, bounce buffers
PSRAM holds frame buffers, the LVGL heap, Matter endpoints and every malloc over 1 KB,
keeping internal RAM for Wi-Fi, BLE and Matter.
week_logger.py: logs the console, follows the
hourly health line, gives a week-gate verdict
ota_serve.py: serves a test build on :8070
hm_frame.py: build / check V3 frames by hand
RS485 daisy chain, one twisted pair
Each poll reads a stat's whole DCB (a PRT/HW-N's is 97 bytes in 5/2 mode, 293 in 7-day).
Writable over RS485: frost 17, set temp 18, on/off 21, key lock 22, run mode 23, holiday 24, hold 32, hot water 42, clock 43, comfort levels, timers.
events: updated, online, offline, write done, found
